On September 8, Canada is set to enact tariffs ranging from 15% to 50% on over 700 American goods in an effort to match US tariffs dollar for dollar, Canadian officials announced on Tuesday.

Notably, Canada is doubling its duties on US steel and aluminum to 50%, in line with the 50% tariffs the US had already imposed on Canadian steel and aluminum before the latest round of US tariffs. Canadian officials framed the move as a means of protecting Canadian manufacturing.

author: CNN
description:
The Alternative for Germany (AfD) party has secured a historic victory in the eastern region of Saxony-Anhalt, the closest a far-right party has come to holding power in a German state since World War II.

The party leaders and their lead candidate were overjoyed as the results were read out, whooping and backslapping as they secured their “historic” victory with 44% of the votes, according to preliminary results. The win delivered the AfD 39 of 83 seats in parliament, just short of the 42 it needed for an absolute majority.

The questions facing the AfD now are whether to govern in coalition or go alone in a minority. All mainstream parties have ruled out working with the AfD, which was classified as “extremist” by German intelligence for its anti-Muslim and anti-migrant rhetoric.

0:00 Far-right extremist German political party AfD wins state election in Saxony-Anhalt state
0:51 German Chancellor Friedrich Merz reacts to the election results
1:36 CNN's Frederik Pleitgen reports from
title: Far-right German party wins state election; what's next

author: CNN
description:
US envoy Steve Witkoff and President Donald Trump’s son-in-law Jared Kushner pushed for a return to trilateral talks between the US, Russia and Ukraine on Sunday after “substantive” discussions with Ukrainian officials in Kyiv. 

It marks their first visit to the Ukrainian capital since the war began and comes amid near-constant Russian missile and drone strikes on the city. Although no major breakthroughs were announced after Sunday’s talks, Witkoff said he was “confident that there’ll be a good resolution here.” 

Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky said “several new ideas” were discussed during “good discussions” with the US, but did not expand on what those ideas were.

description:
President Donald Trump posted a map of New Mexico with “Mexico” crossed out and replaced with “America” on social media, then followed up with a video about the name change.

Although the president does have the authority to change the names of geographic locations like Lake Ontario in the US government's database, he cannot legally rename a state.
title: Trump appears to have a new name for New Mexico
